positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Participate in daily standups and Agile ceremonies across onshore and offshore teams.
Enhance, maintain, and eventually modernize an Excel-based VBA tool for internal plan setup workflows.
Develop, test, and maintain backend services and APls using NET (C#)
I Collaborate with Software Engineers, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to optimize applications and transition business logic from Excel to web
I Integrate third-party and cloud-based technologies (Azure, AWS, Windows Server) 
Contribute to sprint planning, backlog grooming, and team syncs
I Create and maintain technical documentation including architecture, design, and troubleshooting guides
I foster team connection through regular non-work check-ins and shared team values

positions.title: Software Engineer 1
positions.description:
Responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of new and existing features for the existing portfolio of applications for a business area.

Design, codes, configures, unit tests, maintains, and documents software deliverables using agreed upon standards and tools. Participates in sizing and estimation activities within the agile team.

Participates in code reviews and sprint retrospectives; ensuring their ideas for team continuous improvement are communicated so that the overall process and team can improve sprint by sprint and readily receives feedback for self-improvement. May lead parts of same.

positions.title: Modis Contractor - Test Engineer 1
positions.description:
Communicated daily with team on progress made, what roadblocks that I would be encountering, what am I planning for the day.
Configured, coded, and made unit test for new and existing features.
Manually tested new and existing features to ensure the quality of those features meet our acceptance criteria.

positions.title: Mobile Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Maintained both iOS and Android apps and made sure that they are up to date and free of bugs.
Implemented and designed features for both iOS and Android apps.
Created unit tests for features for both iOS and Android apps, making sure that the code is correctly being called and showing the correct value/state.
Experienced with both Xcode and Android Studios.

positions.title: PC Install Technician Intern
positions.description:
Responsible for the installation and maintenance of corporate computers that include laptops and desktops.
Maintained inventory of computer and components.
Kept stock of end-of-life computers and prepped them for disposal or donations.

company.name: The University of Tennessee at Chattanooga

positions.title: Telecommunications Specialist
positions.description:
Responsible for the design, installation, and maintenance of all voice and data infrastructure.
Offered technical support to client-on-site.
Ensured all emergency phones on-site are up to university security standards.
Maintained and updated all location of jacks on campus for security purpose.

positions.title: Senior Resident Assistant
positions.description:
Served as a student advisor for the complex council and set the semester weekend schedule.
Lead staff meetings and staff training at the discretion of the Resident Director.
Assisted the Resident Director with any needs that needed to be done in the complex or with the complex staff.

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description:
Assist in the supervision of the residence hall, responding to all requests and emergencies during duty hours. Remain on-call for the remainder of the weekend.
Contacted the appropriate Residence Life administrator on behalf of the residents regarding issues of concern to the residents.
Be available to residents on a daily basis.
